We also evaluated model summaries in a judgment elicitation study via Amazon Mechanical Turk. Native English speakers (self-reported) were asked to rate query-summary pairs on two dimensions: Succinctness (does the summary avoid unnecessary detail and redundant information?) and Coherence (does the summary make logical sense?). The ratings were obtained using a five point Likert scale. In addition, participants were asked to assess the Relevance of the summary to the query.
